question: Will Kai and Speed beat the Minecraft challenge by August 17?
resolution_criteria:
Kai Cenat and IShowSpeed are scheduled to stream a hardcore Minecraft marathon on August 7, 2026, at 5:00 PM ET. They will attempt a challenge to defeat the Ender Dragon, the Wither, the Warden, and the Elder Guardian in a hardcore Minecraft world on Java Edition, on the same seed, without either player dying in-game. 

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Kai and Speed complete the aforementioned challenge live on stream between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

All four objectives must be completed on the same seed and in the same world. Progress across multiple seeds will not be combined.

Any successful attempt within the specified timeframe will qualify; however, no challenge progress may be carried over following an in-game death and the beginning of a new attempt. 

Practice or casual worlds not set to Hardcore will not count. No event will count if it occurs while the player in question is in Creative or Spectator mode, or if it results from the use of commands, cheats, or any external tool to spawn entities, alter the world, or deal damage.

Only completion of the challenge as defined above will qualify. If Kai and Speed modify the rules of the challenge at any point, including by removing an objective, adding a player, or playing outside of Hardcore mode, any completion achieved under the modified rules will not count toward resolution.

Only events occurring while at least one of the two players is broadcasting the challenge live will count. Footage of off-stream or previously recorded attempts will not qualify.

If the challenge is cancelled by, abandoned before completion by, or delayed to a point after the specified date, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be footage from the official broadcasts of the challenge on Kai Cenat's and IShowSpeed's official broadcasts on YouTube and Twitch.

# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't confirm the outcome from anything dated on or before 2026-08-10. Every page fetch was refused by the proxy, so all of the following comes from search-result snippets. Several results were dated after the cutoff, and I have left them out completely.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names Kai Cenat's and IShowSpeed's official YouTube and Twitch broadcasts as the resolution source. I could not open them, so I have no live status or VOD state to report.
- 2026-08-07 (pre-event): Coverage said the stream would run on Kai Cenat's Twitch and IShowSpeed's YouTube, starting Friday August 7 at 5:00 PM EDT. [Shane the Gamer](https://www.shanethegamer.com/esports-news/ishowspeed-kai-cenat-minecraft-hardcore-stream-start-time/)

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-08-10)
- I found no source dated on or before 2026-08-10 saying the challenge was finished. On the evidence I can use, it was still unresolved and the stream was still running.
- Undated snippets I could not open describe early setbacks. One says Speed reset a Hardcore world about 10 hours in after dying to a Piglin in the Nether ([Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/gaming/kai-cenat-crashes-out-after-ishowspeed-lost-progress-from-their-10-hour-minecraft-run-3397314/), [Threads/Dexerto](https://www.threads.com/@dexerto/post/Db8Q7OAFVx6/i-show-speed-reset-his-and-kai-cenats-hour-hardcore-minecraft-world-after-he/)). Another says they lost about 13 hours of progress to the Ender Dragon ([Sportskeeda](https://sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-kai-cenat-ishowspeed-break-stream-losing-13-hours-hardcore-minecraft-progress-ender-dragon-3a8254bb)). A third has Kai offering Speed "an out" from the marathon ([Sportskeeda](https://www.sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-you-deserve-free-kai-cenat-gives-ishowspeed-hardcore-minecraft-marathon)). I could not confirm the dates on any of these.
- A Dot Esports headline reports Speed at about 25 deaths ([Dot Esports](https://dotesports.com/streaming/news/speed-kai-minecraft-hardcore-bosses-25-deaths)). I couldn't confirm its date either.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-08 to 08-10 (dates approximate, could not verify): The articles in section 2 describe several world resets in the first few days. Each death wiped all progress, as the rules require.
- 2026-08-07: The marathon started. The goal was to beat the Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden and Elder Guardian in one Hardcore world; if either player died, the world was deleted and they started over. [Sportskeeda](https://www.sportskeeda.com/minecraft/news-ishowspeed-kai-cenat-announce-minecraft-hardcore-stream-defeat-every-boss)
- 2026-08-06: UNILAD Tech ran a piece headlined "Pro Minecraft player warns Kai Cenat and IShowSpeed's new stream 'may never end'". [UNILAD Tech](https://www.uniladtech.com/social-media/kai-cenat-ishowspeed-stream-minecraft-pro-never-end-072808-20260806)
- Earlier: Kai said the next collaboration would be a Hardcore Minecraft marathon. [Sportskeeda](https://sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-kai-cenat-announces-next-collaboration-ishowspeed-hardcore-minecraft-marathon)

## 4. Base rates
- The pair's earlier Hardcore Minecraft collab (pre-2026 coverage calls it "last year") took about 105 to 106 hours, with 42 total deaths, and only required beating the Ender Dragon. [Sportskeeda](https://www.sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-kai-cenat-ishowspeed-finally-beat-hardcore-minecraft-105-hours-marathon-livestream), [Sportskeeda announcement](https://www.sportskeeda.com/minecraft/news-ishowspeed-kai-cenat-announce-minecraft-hardcore-stream-defeat-every-boss)
- This year's challenge adds three harder bosses on top of the Dragon. The Wither and Warden are much more dangerous than the Dragon for inexperienced players.
- A rough time check: by the forecast close (Aug 10, 11:04 UTC) about 66 hours had passed since the start. The Aug 17 11:59 PM ET deadline is about 247 hours after the start. That is more than twice the time the earlier, easier run needed, assuming the stream runs continuously.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has an event called "Kai and Speed beat Minecraft challenge by...?" with several date brackets. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/kai-and-speed-beat-minecraft-challenge-byptptpt-20260807141254095) (the page wouldn't load)
- A related death-count market for "90 or more total deaths" was showing 83¢ at one snapshot (date unclear). [Orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/will-kai-and-speed-have-90-or-more-total-in-game-deaths-during-their-minecraft-marathon-20260807054442845)
- Digitechbytes pages claim these markets were at 100% YES. They are marked as AI-generated and quote an unverified "Polymarket spokesperson", so I don't consider them reliable. [digitechbytes](https://digitechbytes.com/emerging-consumer-tech-explained/will-kai-and-speed-beat-the-minecraft-challenge-by-august-14/)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold markets and no expert forecasts beyond the UNILAD "may never end" warning.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- If the stream keeps going, the deciding moments are the boss fights on whatever world is current. The Warden and Wither are the riskiest; any single death resets everything.
- Things to watch:
  - whether the stream is paused, cut short or ended
  - whether either streamer leaves (Kai has already offered Speed an exit)
  - any rule changes, such as dropping a boss or adding a player, which would disqualify a completion under the criteria

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I couldn't find anything dated on or before 2026-08-10 that settles this question. On the morning of Aug 9, the pair had about 48 hours of play, 31 deaths and no boss progress. Several pages surfaced in searches are clearly dated after the cutoff and report the outcome. I ignored them as instructed. Direct page fetches failed through the proxy, so the facts below come from search-result snippets.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is the live broadcast footage on Kai Cenat's Twitch and IShowSpeed's YouTube. Neither channel could be checked directly, and I found no status page with a boss checklist dated on or before Aug 10.
- 2026-08-05: Kai Cenat announced: "Kai X Speed Minecraft Marathon Can't get off until we BEAT Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian & Ender Dragon ON HARDCORE." [X/KaiCenat](https://x.com/KaiCenat/status/2085043651516780873)

## 2. Current status (as of the Aug 10 cutoff)
- 2026-08-09 (per the search snippet): a Speed fan account posted "Speed & Kai have officially played 48 hours of Minecraft Hardcore and made 0% progress so far 😭 31 total deaths: Speed 20 | Kai 11." [X/SpeedUpdates1](https://x.com/SpeedUpdates1/status/2086559876629848399)
- Dot Esports ran a "Speed racks up 25 deaths" story during the marathon, before the 31-death post. I couldn't open it to confirm the date. [Dot Esports](https://dotesports.com/streaming/news/speed-kai-minecraft-hardcore-bosses-25-deaths)
- Sportskeeda covered Speed getting emotional when Kai died in lava about 40 hours in. [Sportskeeda](https://sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-why-that-ishowspeed-gets-emotional-kai-cenat-dies-lava-40-hours-hardcore-minecraft-marathon)
- Bottom line: the latest status I could find is about 48 hours played, 31 deaths, and no bosses killed on the current seed. The stream was a "can't get off until we beat it" marathon, and nothing showed it was cancelled or paused.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-09: 48 hours played, 31 deaths, 0% progress (see above). [X/SpeedUpdates1](https://x.com/SpeedUpdates1/status/2086559876629848399)
- About 2026-08-08: TikTok clips show both players dying after a raid farm broke and a Vex escaped. [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@thestreamingplug5/video/7672776273348906260)
- 2026-08-07: The marathon started around 5 PM ET, with Kai on Twitch and Speed on YouTube. One death resets the world. [Shane the Gamer](https://www.shanethegamer.com/news/ishowspeed-kai-cenat-minecraft-hardcore-stream-start-time/), [bo3.gg](https://bo3.gg/games/news/ishowspeed-and-kai-cenat-start-minecraft-hardcore-marathon-without-deaths)
- 2026-08-06: A pro Minecraft player warned the stream "may never end." [UNILAD Tech](https://www.uniladtech.com/social-media/kai-cenat-ishowspeed-stream-minecraft-pro-never-end-072808-20260806)

## 4. Base rates
- In their 2024 hardcore collab, the goal was only the Ender Dragon. It reportedly took about 106 hours of streaming spread over several days. [UNILAD Tech](https://www.uniladtech.com/social-media/kai-cenat-ishowspeed-stream-minecraft-pro-never-end-072808-20260806)
- The 2026 challenge adds three bosses. The Warden and Elder Guardian in particular are dangerous for weak players and slow to prepare for, since they need gear, potions and an ocean monument. That makes a full clear take longer than a dragon-only run.
- The deadline is Aug 17, so they have about 10 days from the start. If they needed more than 106 hours for the dragon alone in 2024, the 2026 goal would plausibly take something like 100 to 150 or more hours. That could fit inside 10 days if they stream almost nonstop, as the "can't get off" pledge suggests. The death rate so far (31 in 48 hours, about one reset every 1.5 hours) shows how fragile each run was. This range is my own rough reasoning from the 2024 figure, not a sourced estimate.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Around 2026-08-08: the "by August 14" market traded around 6¢, with about $24.9K volume. [orrery.me mirror](https://orrery.me/markets/will-kai-and-speed-beat-the-minecraft-challenge-by-august-14-20260807213124703)
- Polymarket's multi-date event page: [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/kai-and-speed-beat-minecraft-challenge-byptptpt-20260807141254095). I couldn't get the August 17 price from on or before Aug 10.
- A related market on "90 or more total deaths" traded around 83¢ in one snapshot (date unclear). [orrery.me](https://orrery.me/markets/will-kai-and-speed-have-90-or-more-total-in-game-deaths-during-their-minecraft-marathon-20260807054442845)
- Some digitechbytes pages claim Polymarket showed 100% YES. They are AI-generated and look unreliable, so I ignored them.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The marathon was set to keep going until the challenge is beaten, so it should run continuously through the Aug 17 deadline unless the streamers stop.
- Things that could change the outcome:
  - deaths that reset the world
  - stopping because of fatigue or sleep breaks
  - any change to the rules, such as dropping Hardcore or adding a helper, which would make a completion not count.
- Off-stream play doesn't count, so pauses between streams matter.

hor is the market. The Aug 14 bracket traded around 6¢ on Aug 8, which implies the Aug 17 bracket was perhaps 10 to 15%. My reference-class base rate for finishing a goal several times harder than one that took 105 hours, within about 247 hours, is roughly 10 to 15%.

(d) Evidence for Yes:
- The "can't get off" pledge from Aug 5 suggests a near-continuous stream.
- Reaching the Dragon in an earlier world (about 13 hours lost, undated) shows they can progress fast within a single world.
- The Elder Guardian and Wither can be cheesed, and about 180 hours remained.

Evidence for No:
- The Aug 9 update showed 48 hours, 31 deaths and zero bosses, about one reset every 1.5 hours.
- The Warden is very lethal for weak players.
- The "may never end" pro warning came on Aug 6.
- Kai offered Speed an out, which raises the risk of quitting or changing the rules.
- The 90+ deaths market traded at 83¢.

(e) No scenario: resets keep coming, especially on the Warden or Wither. Fatigue sets in, the stream pauses or the rules get softened, and Aug 17 passes. Yes scenario: they learn from past runs, play slowly, gear up fully, and clear all four bosses on one world in about 40 to 60 hours, between Aug 13 and 16.

(f) I start near the implied market level of about 12%. I shade down slightly for the zero-progress status after 48 hours and the risk of quitting or rule changes. I don't move further, because the remaining time is long and they had shown they could reach the Dragon.

Probability: 10%

Aug 17 bracket would plausibly be around 10-15%.

(d) Strongest evidence:
- For Yes:
  - The "can't get off until we beat it" pledge, announced Aug 5.
  - They reportedly reached the Dragon on one run, which shows deep progress is possible.
  - About 180 hours of potential stream time remain.
  - Skill improves over a marathon.
- For No:
  - 31 deaths in 48 hours, about one reset every 1.5 hours (Aug 9). A full clear likely needs 20-30+ consecutive deathless hours.
  - The Wither and Warden are much harder than the Dragon.
  - Kai offering Speed an exit and a reported stream break suggest fatigue or abandonment risk.
  - Any rule change voids a completion.
  - The Aug 14 market sat at about 6%.

(e) Scenarios:
- No: Repeated resets continue, the exhausted pair takes breaks, and Speed's schedule or morale ends the stream, or they soften the rules (for example, dropping Hardcore). Nothing qualifying happens by Aug 17.
- Yes: Around days 5-8 they play much more cautiously, perhaps with coaching or safe strategies such as cheesing the Warden and Wither in tunnels. They then string together a 25-hour deathless run that clears all four bosses on stream.

(f) Moving to a final number: I start from about 12-15%, extrapolated from the market. I adjust slightly downward because of the post-Aug 8 signals of fatigue and possible exit, and because each run is so fragile. I adjust slightly upward because they demonstrated they could reach the Dragon. Net, I land near 10%.

Probability: 10%
